# QWEN New Year Treat: Milk Tea or Coffee

Dates: February 6, 2026 – February 12, 2026

Method: Open the QWEN App and enter "Help me order milk tea" (帮我点奶茶) or "I want Nowwa Coffee" (我要喝挪瓦咖啡). It will automatically link to Taobao to place the order.

# GLM Listing Celebration: Free Wang Wang milk 🥛 

Dates: January 8, 2026 – January 16, 2026
